The [[Standard year/Legends|year]] '''750 before the Battle of Yavin (BBY)''' was a period of [[Time/Legends|time]] during the [[Great Peace of the Republic]]. Around that year, the [[Grissmath Dynasty]] established the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nam Chorios/Legends|Nam Chorios]] as a [[Prison/Legends|prison]] colony, but they also seeded the world with the parasitic [[Droch/Legends|drochs]] in order to [[Death/Legends|kill]] off the political prisoners there. However, the crystalline [[tsil]]s of Nam Chorios filtered the [[Star/Legends|sunlight]] in a way that killed most of the weaker drochs and weakened the remainder. In addition, the tsils' nature [[The Force/Legends|Force]] abilities counteracted the life-draining abilities of the drochs, turning them into harmless insects.<ref name="Essential Alien">[[The Essential Guide to Alien Species (real-world book)|''The Essential Guide to Alien Species'']]</ref>
